name: Yamaha Zuma 125
engine: 125 cc air-cooled single, fuel injected, CVT
intro: The chunky 125 Zuma. Fuel injected, with a fuel pump recall on 2009 scooters.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2009 Zuma 125s are in recall 13V035 for a fuel pump that can starve the engine and stall it in hot weather.

recalls.what: Fuel pump may have wrong internal clearances and can fail, stalling the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the fuel pump with a new design free.
